title: Webb County Property Tax First Split Payment Due Monday, Nov. 30 at 6 P.M.
excerpt: Webb County's first split property tax payment is due Monday, Nov. 30, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. The Property Tax Department will stay open until 6:00 p.m. that day to help taxpayers pay on time and avoid penalties and fees.
content:
Webb County's first split property tax payment is due Monday, Nov. 30, 2026, at 6:00 p.m., Tax Assessor-Collector Patricia Barrera announced.

The Property Tax Department will remain open until 6:00 p.m. on Monday, Nov. 30, to help Webb County taxpayers make their property tax payments on time and avoid penalties and fees.

Webb County shared the reminder on its Facebook page Tuesday afternoon.
